comments.body:
Quest name: Biological Research on the North American Crane (Chrono Quest - 19th Century)
Quest location: San Francisco Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r2 Ecological Research, r4 Biology, NAM(North American Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery: Blue Crane discovery (from "The Beauty of its Form" quest) + Black Crowned Crane discovery (from "Bird wearing a crown" quest)
Additional note: "Branch-off" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain
